sheets.caption: Figure B-1 Typical Single Engine Generator Configuration
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: Service-entrance switchboard (main and 8 branch breakers) to a four-pole ATS, generator and generator breaker on the emergency side, essential-loads panel (main and 8 branches); no ratings.

sheets.caption: Figure B-4 Configuration to Supply Multiple ATS
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: Service-entrance switchboard and emergency distribution panel (main and 8 branches each), generator and breaker, two four-pole ATSs each feeding an essential-loads panel (main and 8 branches); no ratings; small on the page, so 300 dpi.

sheets.caption: Figure B-6 Selection Between Redundant Utility Supply and Dual Generators
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: Two utility supplies with transformers, breakers and a tie-breaker, two generators with breakers, three four-pole ATSs in cascade and an essential-loads panel (main and 8 branches); no ratings; small on the page, so 300 dpi.

sheets.caption: Figure B-9 Parallel Generators with Alternate Utility Supply for UPS Systems
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: Normal bus with two utility transformers and breakers, two load breakers and UPS normal and bypass breakers, bus-tie breaker to an emergency bus with two generators and breakers, UPS block; no ratings.

sheets.caption: Figure 4-3. Double-ended substation connected in secondary selective configuration
sheets.description: 480 V double-ended secondary-selective board: three utility transformers, two optional standby generators, about 25 breakers with a normally open tie, a UPS feeding a 480 V UPS bus with three 480-120/208 V transformers, a 120/208 V board, notes block; voltages but no ampere ratings.

sheets.caption: Figure 4-7. UPS distribution panels
sheets.description: UPS one-line: rectifier/charger, 125 V DC battery, two inverters and static transfer switch as blocks, five CB breakers, 600 A main to a 120/208 V UPS switchboard with four 200 A feeders; near-duplicate of the lower half of tm5-694-p76.

sheets.caption: Figure 4-1. Main power system single line diagram
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: Two 34.5 kV sources with 600 A circuit switchers, two 12/15 MVA transformers, 13.8 kV 1200 A metal-clad switchgear in two sections with mains, normally open tie and eight 600 A drawout feeders, PTs, CTs and about 40 ANSI device-number relays with legend; drawn landscape, rotated 90 degrees clockwise; symbols small, so 300 dpi.

sheets.caption: Figure 5-1. Standby power system single line diagram
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: 480 V utility power centre with two 1600 A and three 800 A drawout breakers (solid-state trip), three 500 kW 480 V generators with regulator, governor and sync panel, PTs, sync relay and relay bubbles with legend; rotated 90 degrees clockwise; symbols small, so 300 dpi.

sheets.caption: Figure 6-1. Uninterruptible power supply system single line diagram
sheets.kind: raster export of a CAD drawing
sheets.description: 480 V utility power centre with 300 A breakers, 400 A ATS and 200 kW generator, two 200 kVA UPS modules (rectifier, inverter, static and bypass switches), 125 V DC battery, 200 kVA isolation transformer, 120/208 V UPS switchboard with 600 A main and four 200 A feeders; rotated 90 degrees clockwise; 300 dpi.

sheets.caption: Detail title: Single or multiple mission critical buildings, standby generators in energy center and essential electrical system generators at patient care building
sheets.description: Medical-centre topology: two utility services and standby generators on MV drawout breakers with ties, LV paralleling switchboard with three EES generators, three ATSs (LS, C, E), patient-care normal-loads board with six LV drawout feeders, legend, general notes, VA title block; ratings only as 800 A max.

sheets.caption: Detail title: Single or multiple mission critical buildings, standby and essential electrical system generators at energy center
sheets.description: Generators at the energy centre: standby and essential generators and two utility services on numbered MV drawout breakers (1 to 19) with NO/NC ties, patient-care essential and normal boards with LV drawout feeders and three ATSs, keyed notes, legend, general notes, VA title block.

sheets.caption: FIGURE 1-1 Typical Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution System
sheets.description: Station and substation transformers, a distribution transformer and a secondary bus with eight branch circuit breakers to utilisation equipment, leader-arrow labels; no ratings.

sheets.caption: FIGURE 1-6 Expanded Radial Distribution System
sheets.description: Main breaker and five feeder breakers on a primary bus, five load-centre branches each with disconnect switch, transformer and secondary breaker, one with a five-way secondary board; no ratings.

sheets.caption: FIGURE 1-7 Primary Selective Distribution System
sheets.description: Two supply breakers on duplicate primary feeders, four transfer switches, disconnects and fuses, four transformers with network protectors, two secondary boards with seven load breakers each; no ratings.

sheets.caption: FIGURE 1-9 Secondary Selective-Radial Distribution System
sheets.description: Two high-voltage breakers, four disconnect switches and transformers, two double-ended secondary boards each with two mains, a normally open tie and six feeders; no ratings.

sheets.caption: FIGURE 1-10 Secondary Network Distribution System
sheets.voltage: MV primary and LV secondary network
sheets.description: Three high-voltage breakers on three primary feeders, nine disconnect switches, transformers and network protectors on three secondary buses, five load breakers; no ratings.

sheets.caption: Figure 3-2. Redundant Power Feed to Facility
sheets.description: 480Y/277 V double-ended switchboard: two transformers with neutral grounding, two NC mains and an NO tie (two of three closed, interlocked), eight feeder breakers in two groups with load notes; no ampere ratings.

sheets.caption: Figure 4-3. Single-Line of Primary Unit Substation with Two Transformers
sheets.credit: US Army Corps of Engineers (printed under the figure)
sheets.description: Two arrangements of a primary unit substation: feeder breakers either side of a tie with transformers on the bus (some dashed as future), and incoming lines, zig-zag transformers, mains, tie and four feeders; no ratings.

sheets.caption: Figure 4-7 Double Ended Bus
sheets.description: Two supply breakers, a tie breaker and four outgoing breakers on a split bus; the simplest sheet in the set.
